copy: When I say I want to do life with you, I mean:
visual: Back-shot from just behind Aachu and Zuv as they step from a small home threshold into late-afternoon garden light. Faces not visible. Their hands almost meet at the lower frame; a key ring, canvas tote, and soft doorway prove the ordinary-life premise without copying the supplied garden-path screenshot.
cta_intent: make the viewer enter the soft list of ordinary life
camera_angle: low back-shot from doorway height, couple moving away into light
wardrobe: Aachu in a dusty coral cotton kurta with soft cream pants; Zuv in a faded sage overshirt and dark trousers.

text_layout.line_breaks: single line or two balanced lines if needed

copy: I want to take turns brewing coffee every morning.
visual: Countertop POV between two mugs: Aachu's hand nudges one mug forward while Zuv's hand lifts a small kettle. Steam rises softly into the text-safe space. Faces cropped out; the scene is active, not a still life.
camera_angle: low counter-level POV, hands and steam dominant
wardrobe: Aachu in an off-white sleep tee sleeve with a small bracelet; Zuv in a muted navy sleep shirt sleeve.

text_layout.line_breaks: single line or two balanced lines if needed

copy: I want to make grocery lists with you every week.
visual: Over-shoulder table scene from behind Aachu's shoulder: a notebook with loose non-readable scribble marks, two different pens, Zuv's hand sliding a cloth tote closer, and Aachu's hand adding one mark. No legible grocery words except the exact slide text.
camera_angle: over-shoulder side crop, hands and notebook action dominant
wardrobe: Aachu in a faded denim shirt; Zuv in a rust-brown knit sleeve.

text_layout.line_breaks: single line or two balanced lines if needed

copy:
I want to wander aimlessly
through farmers’ markets with you.
visual: Basket-level POV from a crate of tomatoes and flowers as Aachu and Zuv walk away through a soft farmers' market lane. Faces mostly hidden from the back. Aachu points at something off-frame while Zuv carries a tote and slows with her.
cta_intent: move the ordinary life outside without becoming a travel postcard
camera_angle: low produce-crate POV, couple in back-shot mid-distance
wardrobe: Aachu in a soft sage midi dress with a cream tote; Zuv in a light linen shirt and charcoal trousers.

copy: I want to wash the dishes while you dry them.
visual: Side/back shot through sink steam: Aachu's hands are in soap water while Zuv, beside her, dries a plate with a towel. Their shoulders nearly touch, faces mostly turned away, window light soft behind them.
cta_intent: make shared chores feel romantic without polishing them too much
camera_angle: side/back sink-height crop through steam and window light
wardrobe: Aachu in a terracotta home kurti; Zuv in a soft grey cotton tee.

text_layout.line_breaks: single line or two balanced lines if needed

copy:
I want to slow dance in the kitchen,
just because.
visual: Side shot through a half-open kitchen doorway at night: Aachu and Zuv are mostly seen from side/back as they slow dance barefoot near the counter. One clasped hand is visible, Zuv's other hand rests gently at her back, Aachu's hair partly hides her face. Candle or counter lamp glow stays soft; the paper remains neutral ivory, not yellow.
cta_intent: make the ordinary kitchen turn into the love story
camera_angle: doorway side-shot, slightly obscured, bodies lower frame, faces mostly hidden
wardrobe: Aachu in a pale blue cotton house dress; Zuv in a black tee and tan lounge trousers.

copy:
I want to fold laundry while we
toss socks at each other.
visual: Floor-level POV from beside a laundry basket: one sock flies toward the camera while Aachu ducks/laughs in side silhouette and Zuv is half-caught folding another shirt. Faces can stay partial or hidden. The room is tidy enough to feel warm, not messy.
cta_intent: end with human play instead of polished romance
camera_angle: floor-level sock POV, motion crossing foreground, couple side/back in mid-frame
wardrobe: Aachu in a dusty lavender sweatshirt and soft home pants; Zuv in a deep forest green hoodie and dark joggers.
